title: Effect of a Mixture of Probiotics on the Antigen Specific Antibody Response in a Influenza Vaccination Model of Healthy Adults
brief_summary: the aim of the study is to get evidence for an enhancement of immune status in subjects after probiotics mixture consumption ( lactobacillus gasseri PA 16/8, Bifidobacterrium longum SP 07/3, Bifidobacterium bifidum MF 20/5) based on influenza vaccination model - compared to placebo.
condition: Enhancement of Protective Antibody Response After Probiotic Consumption
